richiami.difetto: Front hub assembly may be susceptible to fracture / shear and complete failure.
richiami.rimedio: Stop using the vehicle immediately and remove the part. The distributor will be offering a full refund or delivering a replacement part.
richiami.titolo: FRONT WHEEL HUB ASSEMBLY DOES NOT HAVE THE SURFACE HARDENING IN THE OE PART AND MAY FRACTURE SHEAR OR FAIL COMPLETELY
